052  /**
053   * Just checks if heapsize grows when something is cached, and gets smaller when the same object
054   * is evicted
055   */
056
057  public static void testHeapSizeChanges(final BlockCache toBeTested, final int blockSize) {
058    HFileBlockPair[] blocks = generateHFileBlocks(blockSize, 1);
059    long heapSize = ((HeapSize) toBeTested).heapSize();
060    toBeTested.cacheBlock(blocks[0].blockName, blocks[0].block);
061
062    /* When we cache something HeapSize should always increase */
063    assertTrue(heapSize < ((HeapSize) toBeTested).heapSize());
064
065    toBeTested.evictBlock(blocks[0].blockName);
066
067    /* Post eviction, heapsize should be the same */
068    assertEquals(heapSize, ((HeapSize) toBeTested).heapSize());
069  }
070
071  public static void testCacheMultiThreaded(final BlockCache toBeTested, final int blockSize,
072    final int numThreads, final int numQueries, final double passingScore) throws Exception {
073
074    Configuration conf = new Configuration();
075    MultithreadedTestUtil.TestContext ctx = new MultithreadedTestUtil.TestContext(conf);
076
077    final AtomicInteger totalQueries = new AtomicInteger();
078    final ConcurrentLinkedQueue<HFileBlockPair> blocksToTest = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
079    final AtomicInteger hits = new AtomicInteger();
080    final AtomicInteger miss = new AtomicInteger();
081
082    HFileBlockPair[] blocks = generateHFileBlocks(numQueries, blockSize);
083    blocksToTest.addAll(Arrays.asList(blocks));
084
085    for (int i = 0; i < numThreads; i++) {
086      TestThread t = new MultithreadedTestUtil.RepeatingTestThread(ctx) {
087        @Override
088        public void doAnAction() throws Exception {
089          if (!blocksToTest.isEmpty()) {
090            HFileBlockPair ourBlock = blocksToTest.poll();
091            // if we run out of blocks to test, then we should stop the tests.
092            if (ourBlock == null) {
093              ctx.setStopFlag(true);
094              return;
095            }
096            toBeTested.cacheBlock(ourBlock.blockName, ourBlock.block);
097            Cacheable retrievedBlock = toBeTested.getBlock(ourBlock.blockName, false, false, true);
098            if (retrievedBlock != null) {
099              assertEquals(ourBlock.block, retrievedBlock);
100              toBeTested.evictBlock(ourBlock.blockName);
101              hits.incrementAndGet();
102              assertNull(toBeTested.getBlock(ourBlock.blockName, false, false, true));
103            } else {
104              miss.incrementAndGet();
105            }
106            totalQueries.incrementAndGet();
107          }
108        }
109      };
110      t.setDaemon(true);
111      ctx.addThread(t);
112    }
113    ctx.startThreads();
114    while (!blocksToTest.isEmpty() && ctx.shouldRun()) {
115      Thread.sleep(10);
116    }
117    ctx.stop();
118    if (hits.get() / ((double) hits.get() + (double) miss.get()) < passingScore) {
119      fail("Too many nulls returned. Hits: " + hits.get() + " Misses: " + miss.get());
120    }
121  }
122
123  public static void testCacheSimple(BlockCache toBeTested, int blockSize, int numBlocks)
124    throws Exception {
125
126    HFileBlockPair[] blocks = generateHFileBlocks(blockSize, numBlocks);
127    // Confirm empty
128    for (HFileBlockPair block : blocks) {
129      assertNull(toBeTested.getBlock(block.blockName, true, false, true));
130    }
131
132    // Add blocks
133    for (HFileBlockPair block : blocks) {
134      toBeTested.cacheBlock(block.blockName, block.block);
135    }
136
137    // Check if all blocks are properly cached and contain the right
138    // information, or the blocks are null.
139    // MapMaker makes no guarantees when it will evict, so neither can we.
140
141    for (HFileBlockPair block : blocks) {
142      HFileBlock buf = (HFileBlock) toBeTested.getBlock(block.blockName, true, false, true);
143      if (buf != null) {
144        assertEquals(block.block, buf);
145      }
146    }
147
148    // Re-add some duplicate blocks. Hope nothing breaks.
149
150    for (HFileBlockPair block : blocks) {
151      try {
152        if (toBeTested.getBlock(block.blockName, true, false, true) != null) {
153          toBeTested.cacheBlock(block.blockName, block.block);
154          if (!(toBeTested instanceof BucketCache)) {
155            // BucketCache won't throw exception when caching already cached
156            // block
157            fail("Cache should not allow re-caching a block");
158          }
159        }
160      } catch (RuntimeException re) {
161        // expected
162      }
163    }
164
165    testConvertToJSON(toBeTested);
166
167  }

169  public static void hammerSingleKey(final BlockCache toBeTested, int numThreads, int numQueries)
170    throws Exception {
171    final BlockCacheKey key = new BlockCacheKey("key", 0);
172    final byte[] buf = new byte[5 * 1024];
173    Arrays.fill(buf, (byte) 5);
174
175    final ByteArrayCacheable bac = new ByteArrayCacheable(buf);
176    Configuration conf = new Configuration();
177    MultithreadedTestUtil.TestContext ctx = new MultithreadedTestUtil.TestContext(conf);
178
179    final AtomicInteger totalQueries = new AtomicInteger();
180    toBeTested.cacheBlock(key, bac);
181
182    for (int i = 0; i < numThreads; i++) {
183      TestThread t = new MultithreadedTestUtil.RepeatingTestThread(ctx) {
184        @Override
185        public void doAnAction() throws Exception {
186          ByteArrayCacheable returned =
187            (ByteArrayCacheable) toBeTested.getBlock(key, false, false, true);
188          if (returned != null) {
189            assertArrayEquals(buf, returned.buf);
190          } else {
191            Thread.sleep(10);
192          }
193          totalQueries.incrementAndGet();
194        }
195      };
196
197      t.setDaemon(true);
198      ctx.addThread(t);
199    }
200
201    // add a thread to periodically evict and re-cache the block
202    final long blockEvictPeriod = 50;
203    TestThread t = new MultithreadedTestUtil.RepeatingTestThread(ctx) {
204      @Override
205      public void doAnAction() throws Exception {
206        toBeTested.evictBlock(key);
207        toBeTested.cacheBlock(key, bac);
208        Thread.sleep(blockEvictPeriod);
209      }
210    };
211    t.setDaemon(true);
212    ctx.addThread(t);
213
214    ctx.startThreads();
215    while (totalQueries.get() < numQueries && ctx.shouldRun()) {
216      Thread.sleep(10);
217    }
218    ctx.stop();
219  }

221  public static class ByteArrayCacheable implements Cacheable {
222
223    static final CacheableDeserializer<Cacheable> blockDeserializer =
224      new CacheableDeserializer<Cacheable>() {
225        @Override
226        public int getDeserializerIdentifier() {
227          return deserializerIdentifier;
228        }
229
230        @Override
231        public Cacheable deserialize(ByteBuff b, ByteBuffAllocator alloc) throws IOException {
232          int len = b.getInt();
233          Thread.yield();
234          byte buf[] = new byte[len];
235          b.get(buf);
236          return new ByteArrayCacheable(buf);
237        }
238      };
239
240    final byte[] buf;
241
242    public ByteArrayCacheable(byte[] buf) {
243      this.buf = buf;
244    }
245
246    @Override
247    public long heapSize() {
248      return 4L + buf.length;
249    }
250
251    @Override
252    public int getSerializedLength() {
253      return 4 + buf.length;
254    }
255
256    @Override
257    public void serialize(ByteBuffer destination, boolean includeNextBlockMetadata) {
258      destination.putInt(buf.length);
259      Thread.yield();
260      destination.put(buf);
261      destination.rewind();
262    }
263
264    @Override
265    public CacheableDeserializer<Cacheable> getDeserializer() {
266      return blockDeserializer;
267    }
268
269    private static final int deserializerIdentifier;
270    static {
271      deserializerIdentifier =
272        CacheableDeserializerIdManager.registerDeserializer(blockDeserializer);
273    }
274
275    @Override
276    public BlockType getBlockType() {
277      return BlockType.DATA;
278    }
279  }
280
281  public static HFileBlockPair[] generateHFileBlocks(int blockSize, int numBlocks) {
282    return generateBlocksForPath(blockSize, numBlocks, null);
283  }
284
285  public static HFileBlockPair[] generateBlocksForPath(int blockSize, int numBlocks, Path path) {
286    HFileBlockPair[] returnedBlocks = new HFileBlockPair[numBlocks];
287    Random rand = ThreadLocalRandom.current();
288    HashSet<String> usedStrings = new HashSet<>();
289    for (int i = 0; i < numBlocks; i++) {
290      ByteBuffer cachedBuffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(blockSize);
291      Bytes.random(cachedBuffer.array());
292      cachedBuffer.rewind();
293      int onDiskSizeWithoutHeader = blockSize;
294      int uncompressedSizeWithoutHeader = blockSize;
295      long prevBlockOffset = rand.nextLong();
296      BlockType.DATA.write(cachedBuffer);
297      cachedBuffer.putInt(onDiskSizeWithoutHeader);
298      cachedBuffer.putInt(uncompressedSizeWithoutHeader);
299      cachedBuffer.putLong(prevBlockOffset);
300      cachedBuffer.rewind();
301      HFileContext meta =
302        new HFileContextBuilder().withHBaseCheckSum(false).withIncludesMvcc(includesMemstoreTS)
303          .withIncludesTags(false).withCompression(Compression.Algorithm.NONE)
304          .withBytesPerCheckSum(0).withChecksumType(ChecksumType.NULL).build();
305      HFileBlock generated =
306        new HFileBlock(BlockType.DATA, onDiskSizeWithoutHeader, uncompressedSizeWithoutHeader,
307          prevBlockOffset, ByteBuff.wrap(cachedBuffer), HFileBlock.DONT_FILL_HEADER, blockSize,
308          onDiskSizeWithoutHeader + HConstants.HFILEBLOCK_HEADER_SIZE, -1, meta,
309          ByteBuffAllocator.HEAP);
310      String key = null;
311      long offset = 0;
312      if (path != null) {
313        key = path.getName();
314        offset = i * blockSize;
315      } else {
316        /* No conflicting keys */
317        key = Long.toString(rand.nextLong());
318        while (!usedStrings.add(key)) {
319          key = Long.toString(rand.nextLong());
320        }
321      }
322      returnedBlocks[i] = new HFileBlockPair();
323      returnedBlocks[i].blockName = new BlockCacheKey(key, offset);
324      returnedBlocks[i].block = generated;
325    }
326    return returnedBlocks;
327  }
328
329  public static class HFileBlockPair {
330    BlockCacheKey blockName;
331    HFileBlock block;
332
333    public BlockCacheKey getBlockName() {
334      return this.blockName;
335    }
336
337    public HFileBlock getBlock() {
338      return this.block;
339    }
340  }
341
342  public static void getBlockAndAssertEquals(BlockCache cache, BlockCacheKey key,
343    Cacheable blockToCache, ByteBuffer destBuffer, ByteBuffer expectedBuffer) {
344    destBuffer.clear();
345    cache.cacheBlock(key, blockToCache);
346    Cacheable actualBlock = cache.getBlock(key, false, false, false);
347    try {
348      actualBlock.serialize(destBuffer, true);
349      assertEquals(expectedBuffer, destBuffer);
350    } finally {
351      // Release the reference count increased by getBlock.
352      if (actualBlock != null) {
353        actualBlock.release();
354      }
355    }
356  }

359    try {
360      String json = BlockCacheUtil.toJSON(toBeTested);
361      assertNotNull(json);
362    } catch (Exception e) {
